name: dg-daemon
description: Loopback HTTP+WebSocket daemon hosting many chat sessions for dg:start.

commands.name: serve
commands.description: Run the daemon in the foreground; dg starts this for you

commands.name: status
commands.description: report the live daemon's status, or that none is running

commands.name: start
commands.description: start the daemon in the background, or report the live one

commands.name: stop
commands.description: stop the daemon and its services

options.description: kill the daemon and each service process tree at once

commands.name: restart
commands.description: stop the daemon, then start it again

options.description: kill the daemon and each service process tree at once

commands.name: autostart
commands.description: start the daemon at login through the service manager

commands.name: install
commands.description: install and start the login unit

commands.name: remove
commands.description: disable and remove the login unit

commands.name: status
commands.description: report whether the login unit is installed

commands.name: job
commands.description: run and manage the jobs the daemon runs

commands.name: add
commands.description: add a job from a repository URL, or a command: continuous, on a cron schedule, or at an interval

options.description: how often to run it, e.g. 15m
stop a run that takes longer, e.g. 5m
read one JSON object per item from the output
agent identity to queue new items to
approve the jobs of a repository without asking

commands.name: list
commands.description: show every job

commands.name: status
commands.description: show every job, or one by name

commands.name: enable
commands.description: start the job now and at each daemon start

options.description: answers for the credentials: a file path, or - for stdin

commands.name: setup
commands.description: store the credentials of a job, or fetch them again

options.description: fetch each credential that has a source again
make a new token for the credential prefix of the job

commands.name: disable
commands.description: stop the job and keep it from starting at daemon start

commands.name: start
commands.description: run the job now

commands.name: stop
commands.description: stop the job now

commands.name: restart
commands.description: stop the job, then start it again

commands.name: update
commands.description: change the mode or the settings of a job

options.description: how often to run it, e.g. 15m
stop a run that takes longer
read one JSON object per item from the output
agent identity to queue new items to
approve a repository update without asking
add a credential the job needs (repeatable)

commands.name: remove
commands.description: remove a job

commands.name: logs
commands.description: print the last lines of the job log

commands.name: origin
commands.description: inspect or forget the extension origin the daemon has pinned

commands.name: show
commands.description: print the pinned extension origin, or say none is pinned

commands.name: clear
commands.description: forget the pinned origin so the next connecting extension can pin

commands.name: sessions
commands.description: inspect or clear chat sessions on the running daemon

commands.name: clear
commands.description: close sessions no CLI is attached to

commands.name: service
commands.description: run the long-lived scripts declared under `services` in the daemon config

commands.name: add
commands.description: declare a service in the daemon config

options.description: start it when the daemon starts

commands.name: rm
commands.description: remove a service declaration

commands.name: status
commands.description: show every declared service, or one by label

commands.name: start
commands.description: start a declared service

commands.name: stop
commands.description: stop a declared service

commands.name: completion
commands.description: print the bash, zsh or fish completion script for this program
